description: This file contains utility functions and exports related to onboarding, configuration summarization, workspace management, and gateway reachability checks for the OpenClaw project. It includes functions for handling cancelation, generating tokens, validating inputs, printing headers, applying metadata, formatting SSH hints, ensuring workspace and session directories, moving files to trash, resetting configurations, and probing gateway health.

methods.name: guardCancel
methods.description: Checks if a value is a cancel signal; if so, cancels setup and exits the runtime.

methods.name: summarizeExistingConfig
methods.description: Creates a summary string of key configuration settings.

methods.name: normalizeGatewayTokenInput
methods.description: Trims and validates gateway token input.

methods.name: validateGatewayPasswordInput
methods.description: Validates gateway password input, ensuring it is a non-empty string and not 'null' or 'undefined'.

methods.name: printWizardHeader
methods.description: Logs a stylized ASCII header for the onboarding wizard.

methods.name: applyWizardMetadata
methods.description: Adds metadata about the last run to the configuration object.

methods.name: formatControlUiSshHint
methods.description: Formats SSH command and URLs for remote control UI access.

methods.name: resolveSshTargetHint
methods.description: Resolves SSH target string based on environment variables.

methods.name: ensureWorkspaceAndSessions
methods.description: Ensures the workspace and session directories exist and are initialized.

methods.name: resolveNodeManagerOptions
methods.description: Returns available node manager options for configuration.

methods.name: moveToTrash
methods.description: Attempts to move a specified file or directory to trash.

methods.name: handleReset
methods.description: Resets configuration and optionally workspace by moving files to trash.

methods.name: probeGatewayReachable
methods.description: Checks if the gateway URL is reachable and healthy.

methods.name: waitForGatewayReachable
methods.description: Polls the gateway until it becomes reachable or timeout occurs.

methods.name: summarizeError
methods.description: Creates a summarized string from an error object.
